checks.name: saved state follows displayed labels and actual audio; undoing the changes restores saved status
guidance names missing inputs, then full preview, confirmation and ready; native clips play in source order before save
a thrown lesson save keeps visible and hidden drafts; a reviewed retry succeeds and clears the hidden extras
real IndexedDB success plus a rejected lesson apply is reported truthfully; retry uses the fresh library token without conflict
failed library reuse preserves the current visible and hidden draft; retry replaces it only after lesson acceptance
wrong-word, wrong-language, and invalid reviewed boards are not presented as saved recordings
two editors each connect Preview and Save to their own unique readiness description
saved status and missing-step guidance fit 390 px and 1280 px viewports with local production CSS

limits: Actual React, production core/library/editor source, local production CSS, native IndexedDB, native audio decoding and playback. A supplied WAV and one generated tone test source order and review behavior, not pronunciation quality. Lesson callbacks are controlled to throw before accepting data. Isolated editor only; no physical microphone, speech generation, full-host layout, or cloud delivery.
